status: adaptive development, fixed before new representations or direct outputs are computed
questions: Are all input text and context tokens preserved?
Does context-before-text improve a causal semantic representation?
Does an explicit generic task prompt help?
Can the same frozen 4B model directly make usable decisions without training a new decoder?
annotations: unchanged assistant draft; no new human gold, no target fields in prompts
prompt: latent/context_prompts.py; no labeled examples or per-sample hints
cache: reuse verified legacy cache; newly encode both input variants, no truncation
training: copied independent body branch; frozen 4B; matched initialization hashes and minibatch seeds across input modes
objective: same as intent-study-r2: acceptable NLL + .25 preferred CE + 4 interval strength squared loss + necessity CE
selection: fixed last step, report all three seeds and modes; no best seed/checkpoint
calibration: reuse r1 temperature/threshold candidate grid and objective, calibration stories only

direct_generation.validation: strict JSON contract; invalid outputs retained and counted, fallback none only for proposal metrics

timing_limits: isolated research timings do not establish concurrent TTS or hot-service latency acceptance
limitations: Small 18-family development set already inspected. Any improvement remains development-only; generic prompt provides explicit task information, so only legacy vs context_first isolates ordering. No visual naturalness claim.
